pages.text: An Agegleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a green-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in an asscher cut.$(br2)When activated, the amount of time until nearby animals grow up will be significantly reduced, at the cost of charge for each animal affected.
Murdergleams can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
